top_signals.title: Goldman $2.25 Billion Neos Deal Raises Stakes in Active-ETF Race
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs Group Inc.’s agreement to buy Neos Investments for as much as $2.25 billion marks a new front in Wall Street’s ETF battle: paying up for specialist firms that have found growth beyond the industry’s low-fee giants.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Thousands of Lawyers and Bankers Predicted To Leave London
top_signals.summary:
Thousands of bankers and lawyers are poised to leave London over the next few years.

Irina Anghel explains where they're going and why. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: In pictures: Europe's best solar eclipse since 1999
top_signals.summary: A total solar eclipse crossed Iceland and Spain on Aug. 12, while much of Europe saw a partial eclipse and businesses benefited from demand.
